Title: Advantages and Disadvantages of Adding Solar Panels to a Farm Field
Rows:
• Electricity produced by panels adds income for farmers.
• Panels can keep the soil cool during the `text(day)`.
• Plants that help pollinators can grow under panels.

• Some valuable farmland can be lost.
• Tractors and other large machines cannot fit beneath panels.
• Panels require additional electrical wires and stations.
